title: K-1 Grand Prix: Fighting Illusion Shou
native_title: Ｋ－１ ファイティング イリュージョン 翔
overview: K-1 Fighting Illusion Show is a martial arts sports game licensed by the K-1 kickboxing promotion, featuring the likenesses of 12 real-life fighters from around the world. The game includes a single-player arcade mode against the computer, a two-player versus mode, a tournament mode for up to eight players, and a 3-on-3 team battle mode. There is also an AI Fighter mode where the player selects a fighter, adjusts their stats and moves, and can pit them against another AI fighter or a human player.
